ApplicabilityCreateRequest.description: Requirement must be accessible; scope Subject, when present, is active, effective and belongs to the selected tenant. Rationale is required and nonblank for not_applicable; applicable permits omission. Version, tenant and initial lifecycle are server-controlled.

UuidV7.description: Opaque platform-generated UUIDv7; consumers must not derive semantics from it.

UtcTimestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp with UTC offset Z at the API boundary.

ApplicabilityApproveRequest.description: Approval actor and timestamp come only from the authorized server context; SoD remains mandatory.

RequirementAssessmentCreateRequest.description: Applicability and optional EffectiveConfiguration must be same-tenant and compatible; methodology_version_ref resolves a published effective ComplianceMethodology. Initial lifecycle/result state is server-controlled.

RequirementAssessmentSubmitRequest.description: result_status and domain_conclusion are distinct; assessed_at is server-generated.

RequirementAssessmentApproveRequest.description: SoD and the assessed-to-approved precondition are enforced from authoritative state.

SoaCreateRequest.description: Tenant, soa_version, initial draft state, row_version and technical identities are server-controlled.

SoaItemCreateInput.description: Reference and optional tenant Control identities must be accessible and mutually compatible in the selected tenant.

ControlInstantiateRequest.description: Creates only a TENANT_OWNED tenant_instantiated Control and version 1 from an accessible global/platform ControlVersion.

ControlAssessmentCreateRequest.description: Control, version and optional EffectiveConfiguration must be compatible and belong to the selected tenant where applicable.

ControlAssessmentSubmitRequest.description: Overall effectiveness is derived by the compatible methodology and is not client authority; assessed_at is server-generated.

ControlAssessmentApproveRequest.description: SoD and reviewed-to-approved state are enforced from authoritative state.

AssuranceTestCreateRequest.description: Creates only planned state; tenant, row_version, actors and lifecycle timestamps are server-controlled.

AssuranceTestExecuteRequest.description: Executor identity and executed_at are server-derived; samples, when supplied, must be same-tenant and internally consistent.

AssuranceTestApproveRequest.description: SoD and reviewed-to-approved state are enforced from authoritative state.

EvidenceRequestCreateRequest.description: Exactly one approved typed target must be present; target existence, visibility, type and tenant compatibility are validated before persistence.

EvidenceCreateRequest.description: FileObject must be finalized, usable and scan-PASS; all objects and policies must be tenant-compatible. Evidence, first draft version and links are created atomically.

EvidenceLinkCreateInput.description: Exactly one typed target is accepted; a ControlVersion-only link never proves tenant implementation.

EvidenceApproveRequest.description: Decision=approved, reviewer identity and reviewed_at are server-derived; submitter/reviewer SoD is enforced.

EvidenceRejectRequest.description: Decision=rejected, reviewer identity and reviewed_at are server-derived; rejection reason is mandatory.

RetentionPolicyCreateRequest.description: For legal_hold retention_seconds is absent and persisted NULL; for every other kind it is a required nonnegative integer. Precedence must match policy_kind exactly (500/400/300/200/100). effective_from, effective_to, lifecycle, row_version, regulatory source and disposition are not caller-controlled.

RetentionPolicyUpdateRequest.description: Draft-only update; legal_hold omits retention_seconds and all other kinds require it. Strong If-Match supplies row_version. Policy identity, kind, trigger, precedence and lifecycle remain server-controlled.

RetentionPolicyTransitionRequest.description: Empty command body. The sole API concurrency precondition is the strong If-Match header.

IssueCreateRequest.description: Exactly one Core GRC typed origin is accepted in Phase 5; risk, incident, supplier and audit origins remain outside this slice.

IssueTriageRequest.description: Severity and priority remain distinct from the open-to-triaged lifecycle transition.

IssueVerifyCloseRequest.description: Verifier identity and closed_at are server-derived; required SoD is enforced before closing the Issue.

ActionCreateRequest.description: Parent Issue is the path identity and must belong to the selected tenant; initial state is pending.

ActionSubmitForReviewRequest.description: Executes only action.submit_review from in_progress to in_review.

ActionCompleteRequest.description: Closure EvidenceVersion must be eligible and same-tenant; completion is allowed only from in_review and never verifies the Action.

ActionVerifyRequest.description: Verifier identity and verified_at are server-derived; the verifier/completer SoD policy is enforced.
